title: PeerGraph.eth
tagline: A ranking algorithm based of data from Farcaster social graph.
description:
We come from the direction on that almost all search algorithms are generic and with a huge incentive to be corrupted. We aim to create a personal algorithm where the user opt-in with there shared data - in our case Farcaster social graph, where we take the user's friends and look-up how many of the friend are following each specific ETH layer 2 protocol. We believe this is a start of rabbit hole of an individual choose of getting closer to truth. With a way higher barrier of corrupt the algorithm. The social graph also make it sybil resistant, by the user curating there own social feed.

"Only take advice from people you look up to"
how_its_made:
We are using Neynar to connect to Farcaster, with Farcaster login, and Dune for data. We use Next.js, Typescript and Tailwind. 

The app is open source and can be plugged in to your own Dashboard. Currently, we believe this metric is well suited for community dashboards like https://theincognita.com/
